Sandbox_TripwireAlert_SoundRadius_toolti: How far zombies can hear the bell, in tiles.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_PlayerTrip_tooltip: If enabled, walking onto an armed tripwire rings the bell. Crouch/stealth to pass without breaking the line.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_AttractZombies_too: If enabled, the bell pulls zombies toward the tripwire. If disabled, you still hear the bell but zombies ignore it.
Sandbox_TripwireAlert_ArmTime_tooltip: How long it takes to arm, disarm, or pick up a tripwire.
